title: Product Specialist – Trenton, NJ
description:
Product Specialist – Asset Cloud System
Location: Trenton, NJ
Duration: 6+ Months

Job description:
The Product Specialist position is responsible for accurate data entry, process improvement, and ongoing support of inventory management across multiple locations.

In-Person Interviews
This position requires on-site work 5 days a week, with the possibility of up to 2 remote days depending on work tasks and demonstrated
strong performance over time.
Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years' demonstrated experience working with inventory- or asset-tracking systems in an IT or data management consulting role is highly preferred.
- Hands-on experience with data entry, extraction, and reconciliation processes using cloud-based platforms; direct experience with Wasp Barcode's Asset Cloud system is highly preferred.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data manipulation, importing/exporting, and spreadsheet troubleshooting.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Forms for collecting and organizing data from multiple stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, validation, and audit processes.
- Ability to learn and navigate new software quickly, with a focus on process improvement and documentation.
- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
- Experience reconciling inventory reports and managing multiple data sources.
- Proven ability to handle sensitive asset and personnel information confidentially and securely.

Responsibilities:
- Enter asset data into the Asset Cloud system, including complex "multi-quantity” entries that require multi-step procedures and validation.
- Mark and manage work from home (WFH) assets within the Asset Cloud system, ensuring all remote assets are accurately categorized and tracked.
- Develop and implement a new, simplified process for tracking WFH assets to improve efficiency, reporting, and auditing.
- Conduct scanning and auditing of NJ Courts assets in Asset Cloud, ensuring accuracy and full compliance during the annual fiscal year-end inventory process.
- Extract and upload asset, employee, vendor, and manufacturer information using Excel spreadsheets and tools, ensuring comprehensive data migration and integrity.
- Utilize Microsoft Forms to gather asset information from 500+ municipalities and systematically integrate this data into the Asset Cloud system.
- Reconcile inventory reports by comparing system data with physical counts, resolving discrepancies, and preparing reconciliation summaries.
- Maintain up-to-date records of assets, employees, vendors, and manufacturers within Asset Cloud, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Provide customer support and guidance to Central
Office and 21 counties for all Asset Cloud system and asset tracking
initiatives, including troubleshooting, training, and ongoing assistance.

Collaborate with management and operational teams to
gather required information and troubleshoot data inconsistencies.

Document processes, recommend workflow improvements,
and share best practices for future system use.

Provide ongoing support and training to staff
regarding Asset Cloud data entry and reporting procedures as needed.

title: Vendor Manager-Remote
description:
Job Title: Vendor Manager

Role Overview:

The Vendor Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of Hadron's third-party service providers, technology vendors, and consulting partners. This role will report to the Director of PMO and ensure that vendors deliver services in alignment with contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs), operational standards, and the governance framework established by the Project Management Office (PMO). The Vendor Manager will collaborate closely with legal, compliance, operations, IT, underwriting, finance, and the PMO to drive vendor performance, ensure alignment with project delivery needs, manage risk, and maximize value.

Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities

  • Business analyst
    • Review Due Diligence requirements to be implemented in the TPRM tool
    • Follow up with TPRM vendor to ensure full implementation of the due diligence's workflow based on the level of risk
    • Train client users to the TPRM tool
  • Vendor Management and Governance
    • Own and manage the full vendor lifecycle: selection, onboarding, performance monitoring, and offboarding, ensuring consistency across Hadron's US, UK, and EU entities.
    • Maintain a centralized vendor database, tracking contract terms, renewal dates, and performance metrics using PM tools, TPA tracking systems, and contract management platforms.
    • Develop and lead regular vendor reviews, scorecards, and business reviews to ensure optimal service delivery in alignment with PMO expectations and international governance standards.
    • Own and manage the full vendor lifecycle: selection, onboarding, performance monitoring, and offboarding.
    • Maintain a centralized vendor database, tracking contract terms, renewal dates, and performance metrics using PM tools, TPA tracking systems, and contract management platforms.
    • Develop and lead regular vendor reviews, scorecards, and business reviews to ensure optimal service delivery in alignment with PMO expectations.
  • Contract Negotiation and Compliance
    • Support contract negotiations in collaboration with Legal and Procurement for US, UK and Europe territories.
    • Review drafts of contractual agreements to ensure alignment with Hadron's operational requirements and international regulatory standards.
    • Ensure vendors meet all regulatory, data privacy, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
    • Monitor adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and escalate non-performance issues as needed.
  • Operational Support and Risk Management
    • Partner with business units to understand service needs and vendor dependencies.
    • Conduct vendor risk assessments and drive mitigation plans where needed.
    • Manage issues, escalations, and resolution processes with vendors.
  • Strategic Sourcing and Cost Optimization
    • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, service improvement, and innovation through vendor partnerships.
    • Collaborate with Finance to track vendor-related budgets, invoices, and payment approvals.
    • Provide your expertise and engage with external research companies to understand trends in the industry and create a point of view on competitive pricing, delivery locations, and emerging opportunities/risks.
    • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, service improvement, and innovation through vendor partnerships.
    • Collaborate with Finance to track vendor-related budgets, invoices, and payment approvals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Insurance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of vendor management experience, preferably in the insurance, financial services, or technology consulting sectors.
  • Strong understanding of vendor risk management, regulatory compliance, and contracting principles.
  • Excellent negotiation, project management, and relationship management skills.
  • Proficiency with vendor management tools, contract management systems, the JIRA suite, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments.
  • Experience managing vendors supporting underwriting, policy administration, billing, claims, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, or other relevant regulatory frameworks.

description:

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the implementation and optimization of Cisco Meraki infrastructure, including wireless and switching.
  • Design and manage Cisco SD-WAN deployments to ensure resilient, cost-effective, and high-performance connectivity across distributed locations.
  • Engineer and maintain secure network environments using Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Prisma cloud services.
  • Develop scalable routing and switching architectures using protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and OMP.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Cisco Meraki and SD-WAN technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Panorama, and security policies.
  • Strong understanding of routing and switching protocols and network infrastructure design.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS) and hybrid environments.
  • Proficiency with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., Meraki Dashboard, SolarWinds, vManage).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, Cisco Meraki CMNA/CMNO, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE are highly desirable.

Preferred Skills:

  • Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and network segmentation strategies.
  • Experience with automation and scripting (Python, Ansible) for network configuration and monitoring.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive technical strategy.
